payout_quote: CPSC (Sept 2026 recall announcements, e.g.): 'JKMAX Recalls Heated Blankets and Heating Pads Due to Fire and Burn Hazards — Units: 195,000.' Each CPSC recall notice names the product, hazard, units affected, and the remedy. Recalls find SAFETY REMEDIES for products you already own — this is not income and pays nothing if you do not own a recalled product.
timing: Search is instant; CPSC posts new recalls and safety warnings regularly (weekly announcement batches, e.g., Sept 2026). Remedy timing follows each recall notice.
biggest_catch: Same as R0308: this is product-safety remedies, not money — the remedy is a refund, repair, or replacement of a product you already own. CPSC covers ~15,000 types of consumer products, so you must match your exact product; the portal overlaps heavily with R0308 (recalls.gov is partly CPSC's own feed).
eligibility: Anyone who owns a CPSC-recalled consumer product. Each notice lists exact identifiers (brand, model, batch, where sold).
steps: Go to https://www.cpsc.gov/ and use the Recalls search to check products you own (search by product name, brand, or model).
Match your product exactly against the recall notice — brand, model number, batch, and where/when sold (e.g., 'Sold Exclusively at Target').
Follow the notice's remedy: contact the firm, return the product, or stop using it as directed.
Subscribe to CPSC recall email alerts so new recalls reach you automatically.
catches: Not income — remedies are refund/repair/replacement of owned products.
Must match exact product identifiers; near-matches do not qualify.
Overlaps with R0308 (recalls.gov aggregates CPSC recalls) — consider this the deeper CPSC-specific path.
Report dangerous products via SaferProducts.gov or the CPSC hotline (800-638-2772); reporting is separate from claiming a remedy.
notes: Verified 2026-09-22/23: cpsc.gov recall search is live with September 2026 recalls listed (crawled within hours) and weekly recall announcement batches posted. Overlaps with R0308 by design (recalls.gov is the six-agency portal; CPSC is one of the six) — kept as the CPSC-deep-dive route. In-app, frame as product-safety remedies, never income. No app — website only.
